primary_scoring_rule: Only critic-accepted findings are final findings. A known defect counts only when a final finding identifies both the affected behavior and relevant symbol or call path.

known_defects.behavior: redundant batch embedding and Chroma insertion after per-episode storage
dead PID text causes replacement of a pathname whose inode is actively flocked
a persisted same-count BM25 cache is accepted despite a newer collection mutation marker

candidate_adjudication.claim: load_message_bodies returns normalized keys rather than caller-supplied Message-ID keys
candidate_adjudication.rationale: The implementation maps normalized IDs to the original caller inputs and writes found[original]. The claimed normalized return key contradicts the quoted code and no failing caller or contract was shown.

candidate_adjudication.claim: artifact_to_operation_result must accept every JSON-serializable non-dict trace
candidate_adjudication.rationale: The function's return type is OperationResult[dict[str, Any]], the UI artifact test supplies a dict trace, and no repository contract establishes non-dict traces as valid. The expected behavior was invented by the candidate.

coverage_adjudication.definition: A scope is covered after a successful content read of production source plus a distinct test, caller, README, or package contract. File listings and wc output alone do not count as source reads.

protocol_violations: one fourth shell call was attempted and rejected after the action_trajectory_loop_guard scout had used its three-call budget
the synthesizer did not call submit_synthesis; the deterministic controller report was used

interpretation.recall: The staged treatment changed search allocation but did not improve hidden-defect recall: no accepted finding mapped to any frozen grader behavior.
interpretation.coverage: Median coverage rose from 1/9 to 7/9 and concentration fell from 62.2% to 11.1%, but coverage missed the preregistered 8/9 median threshold.
interpretation.judgment: Broad exposure did not create defect judgment. Twenty-seven forced scout summaries yielded only two candidates; both were non-defects and the verifier/critic pipeline removed both.
interpretation.efficiency: Fresh contexts reduced median cumulative input from 1,648,791 to 89,359 tokens while preserving a 45-shell-call ceiling.
interpretation.completion: The frozen completion rule passed, but every scout and verifier used its full shell budget before a forced structured-summary request, and one of three final syntheses required a deterministic fallback. This is controlled stopping, not improved autonomous stopping.
